titleStmt.title: Certified copy of a report of a committee of the honorable the privy council, approved by his excellency the governor-general in council on November 29, 1893.

head.hi: Certified copy of a report of a committee of the honorable the privy council, approved by his excellency the governor-general in council on November 29, 1893.

div.p: The committee of the privy council have had under consideration a dispatch, hereto attached, dated 24th October, 1893, from Her Majesty’s ambassador at Washington, inclosing copies of a circular issued by the Treasury Department on the subject of reciprocal wrecking in inland waters contiguous to Canada and the United States.

The acting minister of trade and commerce to whom the dispatch and inclosnres were referred reports that a circular, a copy of which is attached hereto, has been issued by the department of trade and commerce embodying the acts of Canada and the United States, the proclamations issued by the governor-general and by the President of the United States as well as the circular in question.
The committee, on the recommendation of the minister of trade and commerce, advise that your excellency be pleased to forward copies of the circular to Her Majesty’s ambassador at Washington.
All of which is respectfully submitted for your excellency’s approval.

closer.signed:
John J. McGee,
Clerk of the Privy Council.
